name: Cucumber (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Cucumber (Cucumis sativus) [Gourds] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 168409 (Cucumber, with peel, raw)
ACS Food Sci. Technol. 2023 doi:10.1021/acsfoodscitech.6c00012 (free amino acids, organic acids, sugars in 8 cucumber varieties, flesh vs peel)
McFeeters et al. 1982 J. Food Sci. doi:10.1111/j.1365-2621.1982.tb12899.x (malic & citric acids in pickling cucumbers)
Organic acids of vegetables IV, PubMed 3811599
Moore et al. 2022 J. Food Sci. doi:10.1111/1750-3841.15990 (free amino acid profile of pickling cucumber)
TWU quantification of sugars and organic acids in 210 cucumber accessions
provenance.curation_notes: Cucumber is a ~95% water, low-solute matrix. Dominant carbon/energy sources for a microbial medium are the free hexoses fructose (~0.87) and glucose (~0.77 g/100g) plus malic acid (~0.2 g/100g), the latter a key organic acid that was entirely missing from the FooDB record. Nitrogen is supplied largely by the free amino acids glutamine, citrulline, arginine and serine. Removed 30+ FooDB noise entries (toxic/trace heavy metals and predicted animal/non-cucumber metabolites).
curation_added: malic acid (dominant organic acid, ~0.2 g/100g) - absent from FooDB record
citric acid (~0.08 g/100g) - absent from FooDB record
quantitative individual sugars (glucose 0.77, fructose 0.87, sucrose 0.04 g/100g)
free L-glutamine (~0.24 g/100g) and free L-citrulline - dominant free amino acids
GABA and asparagine as free amino acids
quantitative vitamin/mineral panel (K 147 mg, vitamin K1 16.3 ug, etc.)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
